hero.subtitle: Step into the elite training sanctuary curated by Mr. R.D. Singh. Olympic bars, precision biomechanics, and relentless iron culture in Indira Nagar.

about.title: WHERE CHAMPIONS ARE MOLDED
about.quote: "THE BARBELL DOESN'T LIE. YOU EITHER LIFT IT OR YOU DON'T. WE TEACH YOU TO NEVER QUIT."
about.author: — Mr. R.D. Singh (Founder & Master Coach)
about.description1: Founded on pure grit and authentic lifting culture, RD Health Club is Gorakhpur's benchmark for strength sports, body transformation, and lifestyle discipline. We refuse mediocre shortcuts.
about.description2: Equipped with specialized power cages, competition platforms, high-tensile cables, and an energy-packed environment where novice lifters and seasoned athletes train shoulder to shoulder.

membership.title: JOIN RD HEALTH CLUB
membership.subtitle: No hidden fees. Premium access to all equipment and facilities in Gorakhpur.

personalTraining.title: PERSONAL TRAINING WITH MR. R.D. SINGH
personalTraining.description: Dedicated 1-on-1 coaching for accelerated fat-loss, bodybuilding prep, or injury rehabilitation. Get direct daily oversight from Gorakhpur's most respected fitness mentor.

trainers.name: Mr. R.D. Singh
trainers.certifications: Gold Medalist Lifter • Master Strength Coach
trainers.bio: Pioneer of modern strength culture in Eastern UP. Having coached over 1,200 athletes, R.D. Singh specializes in biomechanically sound heavy lifting, contest prep, and lasting posture correction.

trainers.name: Aman Yadav
trainers.certifications: K11 Certified Fitness Trainer • CPR & AED
trainers.bio: Focuses on explosive power, athletic conditioning, and high-intensity metabolic splits for dramatic body recomposition.

trainers.name: Priya Mishra
trainers.specialty: Fat Loss, Mobility & Macro Diet Planning
trainers.bio: Designs personalized nutrition and recovery protocols that fit busy lifestyle schedules while maximizing gym results.

facilities.name: Olympic Free Weights & Dumbbell Zone
facilities.desc: Precision calibrated rubber-coated hex dumbbells up to 50kg, cast iron competition plates, and zero-wobble utility benches.

facilities.name: Competition Squat & Power Cages
facilities.desc: Heavy-gauge steel power racks with safety spotter arms, band pegs, and multi-grip pull-up bars for safe, maximal compound lifting.

facilities.name: High-Metabolic Cardio Deck
facilities.desc: Commercial treadmills with high incline, stair climbers, and spin bikes in an air-conditioned, high-ventilation arena.

facilities.name: Dual Adjustable Pulley & Biomechanics
facilities.desc: Smooth-glide dual cable cross towers, lat pulldowns, and plate-loaded leverage machines for safe hypertrophy isolation.

reviews.name: Vikram Srivastava
reviews.comment: RD Health Club is unlike any commercial gym in Gorakhpur. Coach R.D. Singh fixed my deadlift posture within 2 weeks. Lost 14kg in 5 months. The equipment and vibe are unmatched!

reviews.name: Rohit Pandey
reviews.comment: Real iron, no nonsense. The power racks and Olympic plates are top grade. If you are serious about genuine strength and muscle building, there is no other place in town.

reviews.name: Anjali Gupta
reviews.comment: Very safe, air-conditioned, and welcoming environment for women. Trainers give genuine supervision instead of ignoring you. Best decision I made this year.
